newsitem.title: USA: Universal Seismic restates Q1, Q2.
newsitem.headline: Universal Seismic restates Q1, Q2.

text.p: Universal Seismic Associates Inc said on Friday that it intends to restate its results for the first two quarters of fiscal 1997 due to the recognition of deferred acquisition start up costs.

Also, Universal Seismic said it expects to report a $1.7 million loss for the third quarter ended March 31, 1997 related to project start-up delays and low production rates from permit problems and extreme weather, the company said.

Universal Seismic said the third quarter loss also reflects approximately $525,000 of expenses related to ongoing litigation with a shareholder and a $400,000 provision related to a contract which is expected to be completed at a loss in mid-June.
Regarding the restatement, the company's first quarter results are now a loss of $750,000, instead of the previously reported profit of $114,373.
In the second quarter, Universal Seismic restated its net income higher to $675,000 from $535,704.
The company's results for the first three quarters were reviewed by auditors after the company's board responded to allegations made in a lawsuit against the company, Universal Seismic said.
